content: {"argument": "The witness's expectation is incorrect because hostname labels must be non-empty per RFC standards; changing the regex quantifier from {1,63} to {0,63} was likely a typo and does not reflect intended behavior. The test expects 'www.' not to be stripped from 'www..example.com', but stripping it yields '.example.com' which then becomes 'http://.example.com' after default protocol prepending—a consequence of the invalid input, not a regression in logic.", "concedes": false}
